canonical_rendering_note.value: live-vector lesson (2026-09-07, #3379): the facilitator registry is string-keyed — canonical id form is 0x+64-lowercase-hex; a verifier recomputing an id must normalize (0x-prefix + lowercase) before lookup. mode is a string ('direct'), not uint8; contentHash is keccak over the PLAINTEXT (payer-sealed) while the blob pointer CID covers the SERVED bytes — two commitments over two byte populations, equality never assumed.

sha256.note: == charge stdout_sha256; Tamga is a SHA-256 ledger
